reviews.text: Working with TeamCo was a great experience for us from start to finish.  We had the pleasure of working with Tim Smith.  He is calm, respectful, knowledgeable and always available to answer any questions.  He goes above and beyond to handle the project from: filing the claim, being on site while working with the insurance adjuster to ensure all damages are seen and covered, to overseeing the installation of the roof and his crew, as well as magnetizing the yard for a final time to ensure no nails or debris is left. My husband and I were able to sit back during this whole process while Tim made sure the job got done with high standards. We have over a 3000 sq ft home with a steep roof and the install was completed in one day! Glad we chose TeamCo and recommend them to those who are looking for a new roof.
reviews.author: Jennifer Even

reviews.text: I called and spoke to a couple roofing companies before a friend from work told me about TeamCo who recently did their roof. So I called and spoke to Tim Smith and he inspired my confidence from the beginning. They came out quickly and did a VERY comprehensive inspection on the hail damage from last Spring. He worked with my insurance agent and I had very little to do with all of it. I would recommend his services to anyone for their roofing/contracting needs.
reviews.author: Steve C

reviews.text: I regret ever using TeamCo Services to reroof my home! In 40 years of home ownership and dozens of contractors, they are the worst. It took more than 10 months after I first paid Terry Smith to get the work finished. I had originally just asked for an estimate for a cover for my pergola. Terry insisted that I had hail damage to the roof too.  That started a very long back and forth with having to make repeated calls for TeamCo Services to do the work they had agreed to. More than 42 text conversations and 38 phone calls later the job was finally completed. I had every excuse from vacations, to death in the family, to a graduation, to the crew had a wreck, to no one is calling me back. I should have demanded my deposit back and been done with them.
reviews.author: Greg Allman

reviews.text: TeamCo did a great job for us on our roof replacement.  They explained everything, provided a fair quote, did the job promptly, and keep the area clean.    We are happy with our new roof!  We would definitely use them again!
reviews.author: Ginger G

reviews.text: I had a great experience with Terry from Teamco.  He was able to help me get my roof claim approved through my insurance.  Teamco put a new roof on my house and a new fence in my backyard while saving me money on my insurance deductible.  The crew installed the roof in 1 day and it looks absolutely wonderful.  They have done several houses on my street and they all look great.  I have recommended Teamco to my neighbors and would recommend them to you as well.
reviews.author: Jacob Warren

reviews.text:
The TeamCo Services crew did an awesome job and kept us informed  during the whole roof replacement. After the job they cleaned up everything. TeamCo Services is definitely our choice when there is need for any roofing work.
Having TeamCo Services doing the job is real peace of mind.
The Staff of TeamCo Services is outstanding as well.
reviews.author: Jan Verrijcke

reviews.text: Terry was excellent. I submitted a request on the Thumbtack app for a quick fix on my roof. Not only was he the most responsive to messages, he was also by far the best value. Several other big companies messaged me and tried to hit me with “minimum charges for labor” of $250 or more. Terry charges per the job on a case by case basis and was more than fair. He also freed up earlier than our scheduled appointment time, and since it was just a quick small job, asked if he could just run by my house to fix the issue and bill me via PayPal. I agreed, and within 20 minutes I had pictures of the fix and a paypal request from him! Best customer service I’ve ever seen! Thanks again Terry!
reviews.author: Matthew Denney

reviews.text: Cannot speak to a new roof from them as they have not put one of for me. However, as a neighbor in between two TeamCo roofs I am extremely unhappy with their clean up process. After both roofs that went on I have found numerous shingle wrappers, old felt, and pieces of shingle scattered throughout both my front and backyard. On one occasion an employee simply watched as the wind brought a wrapper over into my yard and then went about his business with no intent to clean it up. This sort of business practice does not bode well with me and due this simple experience with them, I am highly unsatisfied.
reviews.author: Kyle Bundas

data.summary: Reviews show a mix of authentic experiences. Positive reviews from 7-8 years ago are generic and clustered, suggesting possible past review solicitation. Recent negative reviews (3 years ago) are highly detailed and credible, indicating a significant decline in service quality or operational problems. The pattern suggests a company that may have provided good service historically but now has serious issues with project management and communication.
fake_signals: Multiple 5-star reviews from 7-8 years ago posted in same timeframe
Generic, repetitive praise in some 5-star reviews lacking specific details
5-star reviews heavily focus on insurance claim assistance rather than construction quality
authentic_signals: Specific negative complaints with detailed timelines and communication counts
Varied writing styles and emotional authenticity in both positive and negative reviews
Negative reviews provide concrete examples of problems (cleanup, delays)
complaint_patterns: Aggressive upselling/pressure to file insurance claims
